王野也不搭话，就那么静静的喝着水。黄飞龙等了一会儿见王野半天也不说话，憋了半天声如蚊蝇般蹦出一句话：“一朝天子，一朝臣。”

王野哈哈一笑：“龙哥，言重了，那有什么天子，什么臣，不都是朋友吗。”

黄飞龙白了一眼王野：“你猜我信吗？”

王野哈哈笑着说：“我猜你信。”

就在这时秦天熙叼着一根儿烟来到了两人身边：“呦～，俩人聊的不错呀！”

黄飞龙站起身：“熙哥，我和王野兄弟也算是不打不相识，有些问题聊开了也就没事儿了。”

王野依旧坐着：“龙哥，这就是你的不对了，我都叫了你这么久的龙哥了，你还叫我王野兄弟，以后叫我小野就行。”

黄飞龙转头微笑道：“行，以后就叫你小野。”

说完歪着头嘴里低声的还重复着：“小野，小野，小爷。”

猛的抬起头，看向王野：“不对呀，你是不是占我便宜？”

王野和秦天熙疑惑的看向黄飞龙：“你让我，叫你小爷，这踏马不是平白高我两辈儿吗？”

秦天熙转头看向王野，王野赶紧解释道：“大哥，龙哥，我要说我没注意到，你们信吗？”

秦天熙一巴掌打在王野的脑袋上笑骂道：“我信你娘......呸，我信个屁。你名字到底谁起的，这不是占人便宜吗？”

王野轻咳一声：“那个，名字是我太爷起的，要不那天我把他老人家请来，你们问问为什么起这么个名？”

秦天熙笑骂道：“就你小子一肚子坏水儿。”

三人说说笑笑回到了餐桌，这顿饭一直吃到十点才结束。王野回到家，悄悄的进入厨房，放下五个三头鲍和鱼翅后才回房睡觉。

第二天一早王野早早的起床，吃早饭时特意交代秦婉不要弄鲍鱼和鱼翅，等他以后再做。这又免不了一顿询问，王野在往回拿这些东西时就想好了说辞。这都是大哥的朋友踅摸来的，和他没有任何关系。

吃过早饭后就出门了，今天的第一站是同仁堂，一进门就看见大师兄正在训话。王野看着程启铭在那里高谈阔论，想到后世打鸡血的老板们，无论什么时候形式主义都是存在的。

等他们的早会开完后，王野才迎上去。嬉皮笑脸的站在程启铭面前：“大师兄，我的药材买回来了吗？”

程启铭没好气的哼了一声：“这会儿知道我是你大师兄了，你个小混蛋，一肚子坏水儿。”

Wang Ye didn't say anything and just drank water quietly.Huang Feilong waited for a while and saw that Wang Ye didn't say anything for a long time. After holding back for a long time, he popped out a sentence like a mosquito or fly: "Once the emperor, once the courtier."

Wang Ye laughed loudly: "Brother Long, I'm serious. Aren't all emperors and ministers all friends?"

Huang Feilong rolled his eyes at Wang Ye: "Do you think I believe it?"

Wang Ye laughed and said, "I guess you believe it."

At this moment, Qin Tianxi came to the two of them with a cigarette in his mouth: "Hey~, the two of them had a good chat!"

Huang Feilong stood up: "Brother Xi, brother Wang Ye and I are not acquainted without fighting. We can talk about some issues and it will be fine."

Wang Ye is still sitting: "Brother Long, this is your fault. I have called you Brother Long for so long, and you still call me brother Wang Ye. From now on, just call me Xiaoye."

Huang Feilong turned around and smiled: "Okay, I'll call you Xiaoye from now on."

After saying that, he tilted his head and repeated in a low voice: "Xiaoye, Xiaoye, Xiaoye."

He raised his head suddenly and looked at Wang Ye: "That's not right, are you taking advantage of me?"

Wang Ye and Qin Tianxi looked at Huang Feilong in confusion: "If you ask me to call you Young Master, isn't this two generations ahead of me for nothing?"

Qin Tianxi turned to look at Wang Ye, and Wang Ye quickly explained: "Brother, Brother Long, if I say that I didn't notice, do you believe me?"

Qin Tianxi slapped Wang Ye on the head and cursed with a smile: "I believe your mother... Bah, I believe bullshit. Who named you? Isn't this taking advantage of others?"

Wang Ye coughed lightly: "Well, the name was given by my grandfather. How about I invite his old man here that day and you ask why he was named like this?"

Qin Tianxi laughed and scolded: "You are the only one who is full of evil."

The three of them chatted and laughed and returned to the dining table. The meal didn't end until ten o'clock.Wang Ye returned home, quietly entered the kitchen, put down five three-headed abalone and shark fins, and then went back to his room to sleep.

Wang Ye got up early the next morning. During breakfast, he specifically told Qin Wan not to cook abalone and shark fin, but to wait for him to do it later.This again inevitably required questioning, and Wang Ye had already thought of an excuse when he went back to get these things.These are all brought by eldest brother's friends and have nothing to do with him.

After breakfast, we went out. The first stop today was Tong Ren Tang. As soon as we entered the door, we saw the senior brother giving a lecture.Wang Ye looked at Cheng Qiming's eloquent talk there, and thought of the bosses of later generations who would always have formalism.

After their morning meeting was over, Wang Ye went up to greet them.Standing in front of Cheng Qiming with a playful smile: "Senior Brother, have you bought my medicinal materials?"

Cheng Qiming snorted angrily: "Now you know that I am your senior brother, you little bastard, full of bad ideas."
